where.if: AND ( o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order o LEFT JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, u.phone AS userPhone, u.nickname AS nickname, o.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS projectTitle, o.session_id AS sessionId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, v.venue_name AS venueName, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.delivery_type AS deliveryType, o.pay_amount AS payAmount, o.ticket_amount AS ticketAmount, o.pay_method AS payMethod, o.create_time AS createTime, o.pay_expire_time AS payExpireTime, o.pay_time AS payTime, o.cancel_time AS cancelTime, o.ticket_issued_time AS ticketIssuedTime, o.finish_time AS finishTime, IFNULL(item_stat.item_count, 0) AS itemCount, IFNULL(audience_stat.audience_count, 0) AS audienceCount, IFNULL(ticket_stat.ticket_count, 0) AS ticketCount, IFNULL(refund_stat.refund_count, 0) AS refundCount FROM ticket_order o LEFT JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id LEFT JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_item GROUP BY order_id ) item_stat ON item_stat.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS audience_count FROM order_audience GROUP BY order_id ) audience_stat ON audience_stat.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM electronic_ticket GROUP BY order_id ) ticket_stat ON ticket_stat.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS refund_count FROM refund_record GROUP BY order_id ) refund_stat ON refund_stat.order_id = o.order_id
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.order_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, u.phone AS userPhone, u.nickname AS nickname, o.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS projectTitle, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, o.session_id AS sessionId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, v.venue_name AS venueName, v.address AS venueAddress, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.delivery_type AS deliveryType, o.ticket_amount AS ticketAmount, o.service_fee_amount AS serviceFeeAmount, o.delivery_fee_amount AS deliveryFeeAmount, o.discount_amount AS discountAmount, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.pay_amount AS payAmount, o.pay_method AS payMethod, o.pay_expire_time AS payExpireTime, o.pay_time AS payTime, o.cancel_time AS cancelTime, o.ticket_issued_time AS ticketIssuedTime, o.finish_time AS finishTime, o.create_time AS createTime, o.update_time AS updateTime FROM ticket_order o LEFT JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id LEFT JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT order_item_id AS orderItemId, sku_id AS skuId, sku_name AS skuName, unit_price AS unitPrice, quantity AS quantity, subtotal_amount AS subtotalAmount FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY order_item_id ASC

SELECT order_audience_id AS orderAudienceId, real_name AS realName, certificate_type AS certificateType, certificate_no AS certificateNo, phone AS phone FROM order_audience WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY order_audience_id ASC

SELECT order_address_id AS orderAddressId, receiver_name AS receiverName, receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, province AS province, city AS city, district AS district, detail_address AS detailAddress FROM order_address WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT ticket_id AS ticketId, ticket_no AS ticketNo, order_item_id AS orderItemId, order_audience_id AS orderAudienceId, ticket_status AS ticketStatus, qr_code_value AS qrCodeValue, seat_info AS seatInfo, generate_time AS generateTime, check_time AS checkTime, expire_time AS expireTime, abnormal_reason AS abnormalReason FROM electronic_ticket WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY ticket_id ASC

SELECT r.refund_id AS refundId, r.refund_no AS refundNo, r.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, u.phone AS userPhone, u.nickname AS nickname, o.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS projectTitle, o.session_id AS sessionId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, r.refund_status AS refundStatus, r.refund_type_snapshot AS refundTypeSnapshot, r.fee_rate_snapshot AS feeRateSnapshot, r.refund_amount AS refundAmount, r.fee_amount AS feeAmount, r.reason AS reason, r.fail_reason AS failReason, r.apply_time AS applyTime, r.refund_time AS refundTime, r.update_time AS updateTime FROM refund_record r LEFT JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id = r.order_id LEFT JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id LEFT JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id WHERE r.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY r.apply_time DESC, r.refund_id DESC
SELECT order_status FROM ticket_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT sku_id AS skuId, quantity AS quantity FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY order_item_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_sku SET stock_available = stock_available + #{quantity}, stock_locked = stock_locked - #{quantity}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND stock_locked >= #{quantity}
UPDATE ticket_order SET order_status = 'CANCELED', cancel_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND order_status = 'WAIT_PAY'
